title: Twenty-four retained interaction ideas, historical cleanup, food/sleep consumers and native mutation evidence

reviews.classification: retained proposal / historical cleanup / scoped gameplay evidence / native-analysis boundaries
reviews.disposition:
Full I01–I24 proposal review under AD5/AD22/AD32/AD38. Preserve the specific interaction deltas, not a claim that romance/factions/museums/teaching were absent or that these are original across all fiction/project documents. The old live-owner novelty comparison and mid-pass hash/final drift check are dated evidence, not a fresh exhaustive novelty survey. All24 ideas remain proposed, not accepted or implemented. The useful interactions are folded by stable IDs into the life-simulation owner, preserving this detailed source palette and its examples.

The named clinic examples are fictional process/recipient choices, not clinical facts or a required medical realism model. Finite cohorts/three slots/three people and I19's single posthumous intervention are authored examples: intervention frequency/quantity/coordination is a world dial with actual means/reason, not a universal once-only power limit. Death/defeat and exceptional multi-body/chorus mechanisms keep their own world owners. A character may freely decline, disagree, change goals or maintain quiet friendship without automatic affection penalties, crises or forced compensation policy. Competence certification records demonstrated scope rather than forbidding independently acquired methods. No player/NPC mind-reading or new universal rank follows from blind evaluation or simultaneous commitment. This full palette read performs no source-game/book qualification or implementation.

reviews.disposition:
Historical housekeeping/proposal inventory under AD32/AD36/AD41/AD42/AD43. X1–X4 sizes, merge ancestry, dirty generated-only worktrees and249GB free were observations at2026-10-14, not live deletion readiness. Even the old Safe verdict requires fresh current ancestry, dirty/index/untracked ownership, recovery and inbound/tool checks before any retirement; this reconciliation grants no deletion, uninstall or branch action. Tool repos support reproducibility; installed game/source payload and retained evidence are separate assets. Other sessions' installs remain outside this brief.

A1's seven failing tests and combined LP2/LP3 requirement decision are historical integration facts, not seven reproduced current failures. Both legitimate return and brace requirements must be tested in combination rather than dropping one to satisfy single-lane tests. K1 combined crowding and K2 combined literal import are named proof gaps; isolated slice passes do not imply combined coverage. The1366 viewport is historical, not today's desktop matrix. K3's40-step harness issue and K4's port collision are diagnostic questions; raising a budget alone does not certify gameplay or resolve a slow/hung route.

Retain L1's four actual cross-slice joins, L2's research-to-owner fold, L3's remaining capture families, L4's ranked unsent re-audits, L5's available-source candidates, L6's120 wool/24 failed cloth attempts and L7's read-only method inspector. Those outcomes are useful alternatives, not present implementation/acquisition/dispatch authority. A finite unlucky replay does not alone establish the probability distribution or required balance change. Human play is optional AD42 review rather than a universal prerequisite to consider fitting joins. Current source/install state, later merges, native/UI/full-suite behavior and purchase availability were not inspected in this full-document read.

reviews.classification: retained proposal / historical cleanup / scoped gameplay evidence / native-analysis boundaries
reviews.disposition:
Historical15-stage household/food/sleep continuation under AD36/AD42/AD43. The three explicit source windows and5382-word packet separate lead knowledge from other recipients' chapter8 aftermath; edition/Chinese equivalence remains qualified. The lead's chapter9 five-pence statement is not silently minted into the earlier lower-bound purse. Later KJ3E's explicit pocket count/reconstructed seven-pence source conflict and KJ3K's authored copper assumption retain separate boundaries rather than retroactively making this slice a complete household economy.

TD9's finite allocated food converts once through conserved native commands into actual items; retired resource display cannot remain a second spendable pool. The route consumes two of16 loaves and cooks/consumes two potatoes, retaining other groceries. Broader firearms are still a separate consumer. Native template nutrition/sale defaults are not verified canon physiology. Atomic cooking/refund semantics do not establish a partial-boiling simulator. Half-hour rest/three-hour sleep have source duration support, while other timing is authored.

The21 reserveTime:false slots remove unsupported hard-appointment interpretation from reviewed early beats without completing old events or disabling actual resource/state obligations and unreviewed timed reservations. Sleep import's accidental Escape invokes Wake up; correcting that probe is not an app repair. Stop's refund/time copy, stored knowledge-key suffixes, actual money-port readiness and retained Notebook observation projection are separate repaired consumers. A forgotten finding remains absent despite historical completion/pack prose; private account and historical ledger cannot be used to reconstruct memory.

Ten native groups across15 stages use the route bundle, and seven later checks exercise final changed load/presentation consumers with writer/command identity reuse. No final-bundle full-route replay or fresh whole opening is implied. Intermediate4917 suites do not add to final4918/4918. MCP startup does not prove the continuation. Later KJ3B separately supplies the visitor boundary; it is not absent simply because this early receipt ends at the knock. Old preview/PID and named private assets are historical. This full receipt review inspects no private source/fixture/image/current code or test run and grants no deployment/runtime proof.

reviews.classification: retained proposal / historical cleanup / scoped gameplay evidence / native-analysis boundaries
reviews.disposition:
Full public native-audit review, preserving DF-EMR2-05/06 and prior corrected evidence layers under AD32. Native REA/Ghidra work existed in another lane even when an earlier auditor performed no disassembly. PE/unwind/LEA reference checks establish pinned instruction/string locations, not semantic knowledge of every function. Temporary exception/message cleanup and matching0x33 stores do not prove gameplay rollback, atomic saves, material refund or domain status. RTTI/vtable checks identify three effect classes more strongly than nearby strings, but checking24 supplied pointers is not a proven ABI-table boundary or automatically named method role.

The later mutation supplement narrows the earlier slot-meaning gap for selected cores. Preserve distinct selectors, signed widths/overflow and gates: cure-infection clears its selected bit without the same potency calculation; stop-bleeding uses low32-bit multiplication then signed division toward zero/+1 and clamps a negative result after subtracting from a positive counter; heal-tissues has its own wildcard/outer-flag gates, synchronized vector removal, wider stores and conditional mask/counter cleanup. No invented clinical labels or units are attached to unknown fields. Overlapping masks under different conditions mean ordering can matter, not that all three are equivalent unconditional healing. Dispatcher/tick/probability/concentration/anatomical resolution and large feedback tails remain incompletely identified.

DF-EMR2-06 reaches actual selected bilateral association unlinking, owner-pointer clearing and conditional record deletion. Not every cancellation destroys a record; retained/requeued branches and category2..4 behavior differ. A removed reference or freed record does not replenish consumed quantities or prove no duplication/product-insert rollback. Most of the2067-line cancellation body remains unread by that independent audit. Correcting the initially misaligned disassembly window avoids attributing semantics to random bytes. Empty assembly/call arrays and one-byte API function bodies are incomplete tooling output despite API success; independent decode narrows selected cores, not the whole graph.

The entire report, including later supplements, was read here. No PE, decompilation, disassembly, private native artifact, dynamic game, save or linked verification script was inspected or executed in this reconciliation. The captured build identity and analyst assignments remain historical evidence; current YAIR implementation or native-game reproduction does not follow. Preserve concrete undiscovered consumers rather than resetting the audit to string-only evidence or overstating whole-system recovery.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B490: twenty-four specific interaction alternatives
folds.body:
Proposed extensions retained from the completely read [I01–I24 palette](research/far-field-tropes-2026-10-08/PART_3_NEW_IDEAS.md), under AD5/AD22/AD32/AD38. Existing broad social/teaching/knowledge directions already cover the families; these are more specific choices, not missing universal systems, accepted requirements or implementation claims.

I01–I06: NPC-initiated invitation with counteroffer/decline and their independent plan; affection versus practical shared futures; an individual gift's remembered provenance and changed meaning; public support versus private disagreement/audience; household shift exchange with actual opportunity costs; hosting an introduction that creates a durable NPC-to-NPC relationship. Refusal or disagreement need not automatically lower affection or generate a crisis.

I07–I14: curriculum ordering can shape demonstrated competence; a learner can negotiate their own assessment goal; anonymous demonstrations separate reputation from performance; service handoffs create stage-specific bottlenecks; recipients choose whether to wait/referral; demonstrated routine handover supports scoped delegation; menu choices shape guest/encounter composition; festival program order changes which cohort stays. These are authored/world-local possibilities with actual means and consumers, not a universal pedagogy or fictional-clinic treatment model.

I15–I20: evidence chains distinguish independent corroboration from repeated testimony; observation windows and retained rubbings preserve access; actual messengers/topology/knowledge constrain warning reach; simultaneous council commitments preserve uncertainty; posthumous participation can operate through that world's real mechanism; repeal leaves cohorts with different prior costs and possible recognition/compensation choices. I19's single intervention is an illustrative dial, not a universal one-use rule; a past event or later explanation does not grant earlier actor knowledge.

I21–I24: shared care retains one creature's learned repertoire from two homes; coordinated phases let several people act as an apparatus, with alternative real means possible; restoring an exhibit can expose disputed authorship rather than merely trigger a memory; seasonal batch/storage history creates later recipe or social opportunities. Three participants/slots, exact maturation behavior and intervention frequency are examples to fit a world and character. The detailed palette retains scenes, inspirations and novelty limits. Reopen a chosen existing consumer when useful; no new whole-world simulation, implementation queue or source-fiction claim is created by preserving these ideas.
